related_questions.question: What's the quickest way to get rid of COVID symptoms?

text_blocks.snippet: The fastest way to recover from COVID-19 symptoms depends on the severity of the illness. For mild cases, rest, hydration, and over-the-counter medications like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help manage symptoms. For those at higher risk, early treatment with medications like Paxlovid is crucial and must be started within 5-7 days of symptom onset to be effective, according to the CDC.

list.title: Over-the-counter medications:
list.snippet: Pain relievers and fever reducers like acetaminophen or ibuprofen can help manage symptoms like fever, aches, and pains.

list.title: Hydration:
list.snippet: Staying hydrated by drinking plenty of fluids is important.

list.title: Monitor symptoms:
list.snippet: Keep an eye on your symptoms and contact a doctor if they worsen or if you experience any emergency warning signs, says UnityPoint Health.

text_blocks.snippet: For those at higher risk (older adults, those with underlying conditions):

list.title: Early treatment:
list.snippet: If you are at higher risk, it's crucial to seek medical advice as soon as possible.

list.title: Antiviral medications:
list.snippet: Medications like Paxlovid can significantly reduce the risk of severe illness, hospitalization, and death if started within the first 5-7 days of symptom onset.
